plain_english_policy: Enactment would cap political action committee (PAC) contributions to candidates at $1,000 per election cycle.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The bill restricts the financial influence of PACs by setting a strict monetary ceiling on their donations to individual candidates. This policy direction aims to prevent large aggregations of money from single entities (PACs) from dominating candidate funding, thereby promoting a more balanced campaign finance environment where smaller donors or other sources might play a relatively larger role.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced this limitation on PAC spending power.
evidence_quotes: "Under existing law, there are no restrictions regarding the amount of contributions a political action committee may make to a political candidate."
"This bill would limit contributions by a political action committee to a candidate to $1,000 per election."
